Preferred name: Down Syndrome. Definition: A chromosome disorder associated either with an extra CHROMOSOME 21 or an effective TRISOMY for chromosome 21. Preferred name: Encephalomyelitis, Autoimmune, Experimental. Definition: An experimental animal model for central nervous system demyelinating disease. Preferred name: Neurofibromatosis 1. It has been officially transferred to Helicobacter gen. nov. (see Int J Syst Bacteriol 1989 Oct;39(4):297-405). Preferred name: Lymphoma, AIDS-Related. Definition: B-cell lymphoid tumors that occur in association with AIDS.
